concerns.text: The graph shows "T003 ↘ T007", but T007 applies the three transformations implemented in T004 ("Apply the three transformations and baseline") and uses shape strata from T003. The list order (T004 before T007) is correct, but the graph omits the T004 → T007 edge, implying T007 could start after T003 alone. Redraw the edge as T004 → T007 (with T003 as an additional predecessor) so the graph matches the actual data-flow.
